description: This class implements the DistributedPub interface, providing methods to access the publisher actor and to wrap messages for publication using a topic extractor, within the context of a pub/sub system implemented with Akka actors.

classes.name: DistributedPubImpl
classes.description: A package-private implementation of the DistributedPub interface for publishing messages.

methods.name: DistributedPubImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the actor reference for publisher supervision and the topic extractor.

methods.name: getPublisher
methods.description: Returns the actor reference to the publisher supervisor.

methods.name: wrapForPublication
methods.description: Wraps the message with its topics for publication using the Publisher utility.
